title: kbgit.py sync sends code-lane commits straight to main when backlog.json does not parse, since has_code_lane reads the defaults then and the default lane_module is empty
goal: kg_lane.has_code_lane keeps the code lane when backlog.json is unreadable or not valid JSON or gives lane_module a value that is no string; it answers False only for a readable file or a missing one whose lane_module is empty

run: import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_lane;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'init','-q']);open(d+'/backlog.json','w').write('{"lane_module": "kblane"');r=kg_lane.has_code_lane(d);print('truncated backlog.json keeps the code lane:',r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)

import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_lane
def mk(text):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'init','-q'])
    if text is not None:
        open(d+'/backlog.json','w').write(text)
    return d
got=[kg_lane.has_code_lane(mk(t)) for t in (None,'{"lane_module": ""}','{"lane_module": "kblane"}','{"lane_module": "kblane"','{"lane_module": 7}','not json')]
print(got)
sys.exit(0 if got==[False,False,True,True,True,True] else 1)

clauses.clause: kg_lane.has_code_lane keeps the code lane when backlog.json is unreadable or not valid JSON or gives lane_module a value that is no string
it answers False only for a readable file or a missing one whose lane_module is empty
